title: Sam Lyman: “Bitcoin doesn’t need America. America needs Bitcoin.”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Sam Lyman: “Bitcoin doesn’t need America. America needs Bitcoin.” Dollar stablecoins, Sam Lyman says, are "like Starlink for the US dollar system": if you have an internet connection, you can access the dollar. This post Sam Lyman: “Bitcoin doesn’t need America. America needs Bitcoin.” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
